scope: All 516 odpověd-family tokens: 182 valid correspondence verbs, 297 modifiers, 34 nouns, and three adjacent adverb/adjective uses.
choice: Preserve all 182 official technical verbs odpovědati in their correspondence sense; normalize all 297 adjectival/participial modifiers to the official odgovarjajuč- family; use official korespondencija with contextual case and agreement for 31 mapping nouns; recast three mistranslations of German Versagen as neuspěh; use Analogično in two discourse-adverb contexts and odgovarjajuči for one product modifier.
motivation: The official lexicon distinguishes odpovědati (+3) 'correspond/be equivalent' from odgovor/answer vocabulary, but the same odpověd- surface was overloaded across verbs, modifiers, nouns, and a mistranslated German concept. The intervention preserves the valid verb while making modifiers and mapping nouns immediately transparent across branches. German Versagen means failure, not correspondence.
alternatives_rejected: Blanket odpověd-to-odgovarj replacement, because it would erase 182 valid official technical verbs and risk the answer/reply sense.
Use unstable priręđenje/prirěđenje/prirędženje noun variants for all mappings; the official korespondencija head is clearer and morphologically stable.
Retain odpovědanje for German Versagen, which reverses the source meaning.

evidence.german_authority: Versagen eigentlicher Energiesätze at the three source-aligned contexts
